programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries Sophie, who will secure his grandmaster title when he dies. When Man suffers a heart attack, his son must fight Sophie to safeguard the family's gambling business.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: A pregnant painter hires a confinement nanny, but inexplicable incidents start happening in the house as her one-month confinement begins, threatening her and her baby daughter...

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: One More Chance
programme.desc: Chow Yun-Fat plays the unlucky gambler Chui Sui-Fai, whose ex-girlfriend asks him to take care of their autistic son. He reluctantly agreed and the two slowly begin to build their relationship.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: Musician Su reunites with his first love Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: The Police and gambling association team up to overhaul underground gambling by auctioning new casino licenses. This unveils the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: During the SARS outbreak in 2003, a teenage girl struggle to adjust to life in Taipei after returning from LA, due to her mother's sickness & her younger sister's misdiagnoses with SARS.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: Cherry is a young girl addicted to the internet. After watching a creepy video warning about a virtual ghost, she and her unfortunate family begin to encounter mysterious haunting incidents.

programme.title: Hong Kong Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee, a production head of an advertising firm, runs into her ex-boyfriend before a commercial shoot & drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong. She picks herself up with Chan's help.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer gathers a team of thieves to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their plan alters upon finding the legendary 'Moonwatch', leading to a perilous heist amidst a yakuza pursuit.

programme.title: Battle Of The Wolf
programme.desc: A former special forces sergeant must protect his wife and fellow passengers aboard a hijacked plane, using his courage and tactical expertise to take down the terrorists and ensure everyone's safety.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Acting Out of Love
programme.desc: Hung Jen, struggling actor meets Hui Hsin, an associate producer who must write a script for a love story. He invites her out on a date as a research for her script and soon falls in love.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Fatal Visit
programme.desc: To escape a love affair gone bad, Yanny heads to San Jose to visit an old friend, Ling, and her husband. But what seems an ideal, carefree existence hides some unspeakable secrets.

programme.title: The Grandmaster

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: After accidentally killing veteran detective Zhan's wife, Wang Tao seeks redemption by assisting Zhan in tracking a serial killer. However, her involvement puts her in grave danger.

programme.title: Shining for One Thing

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Aaron Kwok plays the Monkey King alongside Gong Li's White Bone Spirit in this powerful sequel to the 2014 box office hit.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier & his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel.

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Celebrity Peng travels to Rome for the shooting of a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Man Man, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy.

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set against four different eras, this 4-part anthology directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng & Shen Teng depicts how China's forefathers fought to defend the nation & family honour.

programme.title: Sky on Fire
programme.desc: Directed by Ringo Lam, Daniel Wu stars as a security chief embroiled in a battle to protect a cure for deadly disease from falling into the wrong hands. Joseph Chang & Zhang Ruo Yun co-star.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: Musician Su reunites with his first love Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: Smashing Frank

programme.title: Endless Battle

programme.title: From Vegas to Macau 3

programme.title: As It Burns

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Body and Soul

programme.desc: NYC's long immigration history and numerous urban and ethnic clusters have greatly influenced its food and culture. Steeped in rich history, Washington, D.C. is home to all three branches of the government — but it’s not all politics and power suits.

programme.title: Barcelona & Rome
programme.desc: Barcelona is defined by quirky architecture, imaginative food and vibrant street life. n "Cucina Romana," is unique to Rome and vastly different from every other part of Italy.

programme.title: Nashville & Chicago
programme.desc: Over the past decade, Nashville has evolved beyond a destination for country music - it’s a culinary powerhouse too. Once known for deep-dish pizza and hot dogs, Chicago is quickly becoming one of the country’s most revered culinary destinations.

programme.title: Honolulu & Los Angeles
programme.desc: Fine dining or a traditional plate lunch in Honolulu, there's no mistaking that myriad cultures influence the islands’ culinary flavors. In L.A., go beyond Hollywood hot spots - these folks serve authentic dishes from across the world.

programme.title: Pre-Gaming!
programme.desc: As a former NFL player, game days hit a little different. These days chef Derrell Smith isn’t on the field, he's changing the game in the kitchen with eats like Philly Cheesesteak Taquitos, Oyster Mushroom Wings and Elote Queso with Chili Lime Chips.

programme.title: Dinner Party
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is hosting a dinner party! Living in KoreaTown, Derrell has fallen in love with its food and culture. Tonight, he's servin' up Braised Beef Short Rib with Crispy Rice Cakes, Pickled Cabbage, Glass Noodles Salad and Korean Pancakes.

programme.title: Game Day
programme.desc: Frankie throws a game day party for under $25. He makes three no-fuss appetizers that are cheaper, healthier, and tastier than subpar game day take out. So gather around with friends and cheer on your favorite teams. Or just eat. Both are a win.

programme.title: Mushroom Mania
programme.desc: Frankie takes us on a magical mushroom trip. They’re an affordable plant-based meat replacement, packed with nutritional value. We’ll learn all things mushrooms and how to make inventive, flavorful dishes that might trip you out on their awesomeness.

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks the summer off right with a burger blowout featuring Brisket Burgers with Grilled Onions and Blue Cheese, Shrimp Burgers with XO Sauce and a Fried Egg, and Lamb Sliders with Feta Ranch and don’t forget the Lemon Oregano Fries.

programme.title: Sausage Egg & Cheese All Day Long
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings out the best of brunch with sweet and savory hits such as Bacon Wrapped Dates Stuffed with Chorizo, Maple Sausage, Egg, & Cheese Fried Rice, and the tastiest BBQ Duck, Egg, & Corn Scallion Pancake Sandwiches you’ve ever eaten.

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde kicks lobster & steak to the curb as he puts a Spanish-style spin on your typical surf ‘n’ turf by creating Pork & Clams, Lobster and Mushroom Fideos, and Tomato & Tuna Bread then washing it all down with a tasty Michelada.

programme.title: Pizza Party on the Grill
programme.desc: It’s Pizza Time! Chef Dale Talde grills up amazing pizzas for every palate including a Detroit Style Pie, a Cheddar Naan Pie with a Spiced Chick Peas & Potatoes, and gives your childhood favorite French Bread Pizza a much needed upgrade.

programme.title: New Orleans-Style Shrimp & Oysters
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde brings us to the bayou as he creates a NOLA-inspired menu complete with Chargrilled Oysters, Black Pepper Shrimp Po’boys, finishes it off with Bananas Foster, and washes it all down with a Fruity Grilled Hurricane.

programme.title: Sunday Vietnamese Brisket with Noodles
programme.desc: Chef Dale Talde shows us how he does Sunday up right as he grills up some Vietnamese Brisket with Rice Noodles, Crispy Swordfish Summer Rolls, and tops it all off with some tasty Soju Floats. Hey, it’s Sunday somewhere, right?

programme.desc: Chef Charles Olalia is teaching us why pork is King in the Philippines! In the menu, Sinuglaw and Grilled Pork Longganisa. Whether feeding a hungry crowd on game day, or any day of the week for that matter – this menu is a winner.

programme.title: It’s All Good Vegetarian
programme.desc: Chef Nyesha Arrington isn’t afraid to mix cultures and flavors to create new and unexpected combinations. In this episode, she is making a play on classic gnocchi with her Cassava Dumplings in Spiced Tomato Sauce. And for dessert, Apple Tarte Tatin.

programme.title: An Italian-American Dream Dinner
programme.desc: Tonight, Chef Daniele Uditi is veering from his classic Italian style and mixing it up with an Italian-American themed spread. He’s serving up cheesy Chicken Parm, with saucy and savory Rigatoni with Vodka Sauce.

programme.title: Meat: More Bang For Your Buck
programme.desc: It's time to reduce the cost of meat on your grocery bill. Frankie shows us which cuts of meat provide the most bang for our buck, and equally as important, how to cook them for optimal flavor.

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: Date night doesn’t have to be at an over-priced, mediocre restaurant. Frankie prepares an affordable and delicious sushi date night at home, plus tips on how to set date night ambiance at home on a struggle budget. That special someone will love it!

programme.title: Burger Off
programme.desc: Nothing says summer like cooking up a burger on the grill! Whether it's a stuffed onion ring burger, chicken katsu burger, or the best salmon burger you've ever tasted...bring out the buns because these burgers will go fast!

programme.title: Oodles of Noodles
programme.desc: Whether it's sweet potato pasta, ramen carbonara, or a leftover pasta frittata, these dishes are a noodle nerd's dream. There'll be carbs all around while we bake, fry, and boil to pasta perfection!

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: As summer heats up, the creators sweat it out in the kitchen putting an original spin on corn ribs and a transforming watermelon into a savory dish. Who will whip up this year’s hottest recipe?

programme.title: Make It or Bake It
programme.desc: Baking videos send our social media feeds in a frenzy and we can’t seem to get enough. Watch as creators impress the judges with a show stopping focaccia, then pay tribute to the mini pancake cereal trend by concocting their own unique cereal.

programme.title: Extra-delicious
programme.desc: They say go big or don’t go at all. When it comes to some viral recipes, going all out is the method to internet madness. Creators customize a burrito made of homemade cotton candy, then shoot for the moon in an over the top nacho spread.

programme.title: Dish in Disguise
programme.desc: The internet falls fast for snacks and hacks that look like one thing but taste like another. Creators must make "donuts" with anything but traditional batter, then flip the script on ramen, using it in an unconventional yet recognizable way.

programme.title: Chicken or the Egg
programme.desc: No matter which came first, neither one is leaving the internet anytime soon. Creators aim to reinvent two iconic viral recipes, starting with a jazzed up egg sandwich sensation, and then their most innovative bucket of fried chicken.

programme.title: Kids At Heart
programme.desc: There’s nothing more nostalgic than eating the good old meals from our childhood. Creators throw it back to some kid-friendly favorites, first with a personal rendition of the fried uncrustable, then with a three-course, microwave-only menu.

programme.title: Springtime
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is ready for springtime and makes a family meal bloom with braised lamb shanks, lemon couscous and a seasonal watermelon and feta salad. His single meals blossom with a simple and savory lamb curry and deliciously fresh lamb gyros.

programme.title: Guys' Night Out
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith shares his Guys’ Night Out favorite moment and meal of lemon pepper chicken wings and loaded fries from his days in Houston playing football. Solo meals also sizzle with Nashville Hot Chicken and Waffles and Curry Chicken Salad.

programme.title: Winter is Here
programme.desc: It’s the dead of winter in Frankie’s kitchen, which means it’s that time for hearty, delicious, and warming homemade meals. So you’re saving more money, while you’re staying in, already saving money. It’s a winter miracle.

programme.title: How Do You Like Them Apples
programme.desc: Apples aren’t just good for keeping the doctor away. Frankie demonstrates how to make the most of this beloved, everyday fruit, from sweet treats to savory meals. There’s a whole world of apples to dive into, especially while they’re in season.

programme.title: Spooktacular Tricks and Treats
programme.desc: Don’t let the line of trick-or-treaters or the candy corn overload scare you out of the kitchen this Halloween. Frankie’s got tricks up his sleeve to make simple yet wicked good treats for everyone at the party to enjoy. All while saving some dough.

programme.title: The Future is Flavor
programme.desc: Frankie harnesses the power of time to transform simple ingredients into flavorful goods that’ll stick around for a long time. Learn the basics of preserving, pickling & curing to make dinner anything but a struggle. It just takes a little patience.

programme.title: Potato Variety Show
programme.desc: Today, Frankie’s slicing, mashing and smashing his way through the spud species, an essential staple for any Struggle kitchen. They’ve got so many talents and textures that whichever way you dig ‘em, potatoes will never let you down.

programme.title: Super Squash
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they’re affordable, abundant and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.title: Let's Play Ball
programme.desc: Batter up! Fall ball is heating up, and Frankie’s offering us his favorite stadium snacks, without those major league prices. No matter who you’re rooting for, these ballpark classics will be a hit with friends and family for seasons to come.

programme.title: Pantry Pasta
programme.desc: Keep your pantry stocked with a few basic staples, and you’ll always have ingredients on hand for dinner, especially for pasta night. In this episode, Frankie creates delicious pasta dishes with the kitchen’s best-kept secret weapon – the pantry.

programme.desc: Chef Nyesha Arrington isn’t afraid to mix cultures and flavors to create new and unexpected combinations. In this episode, she is making a play on classic gnocchi with her Cassava Dumplings in Spiced Tomato Sauce. And for dessert, Apple Tarte Tatin.

programme.title: An Italian-American Dream Dinner
programme.desc: Tonight, Chef Daniele Uditi is veering from his classic Italian style and mixing it up with an Italian-American themed spread. He’s serving up cheesy Chicken Parm, with saucy and savory Rigatoni with Vodka Sauce.

programme.title: Meat: More Bang For Your Buck
programme.desc: It's time to reduce the cost of meat on your grocery bill. Frankie shows us which cuts of meat provide the most bang for our buck, and equally as important, how to cook them for optimal flavor.

programme.title: Date Night
programme.desc: Date night doesn’t have to be at an over-priced, mediocre restaurant. Frankie prepares an affordable and delicious sushi date night at home, plus tips on how to set date night ambiance at home on a struggle budget. That special someone will love it!

programme.title: Burger Off
programme.desc: Nothing says summer like cooking up a burger on the grill! Whether it's a stuffed onion ring burger, chicken katsu burger, or the best salmon burger you've ever tasted...bring out the buns because these burgers will go fast!

programme.title: Oodles of Noodles
programme.desc: Whether it's sweet potato pasta, ramen carbonara, or a leftover pasta frittata, these dishes are a noodle nerd's dream. There'll be carbs all around while we bake, fry, and boil to pasta perfection!

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: As summer heats up, the creators sweat it out in the kitchen putting an original spin on corn ribs and a transforming watermelon into a savory dish. Who will whip up this year’s hottest recipe?

programme.title: Make It or Bake It
programme.desc: Baking videos send our social media feeds in a frenzy and we can’t seem to get enough. Watch as creators impress the judges with a show stopping focaccia, then pay tribute to the mini pancake cereal trend by concocting their own unique cereal.

programme.title: Extra-delicious
programme.desc: They say go big or don’t go at all. When it comes to some viral recipes, going all out is the method to internet madness. Creators customize a burrito made of homemade cotton candy, then shoot for the moon in an over the top nacho spread.

programme.title: Dish in Disguise
programme.desc: The internet falls fast for snacks and hacks that look like one thing but taste like another. Creators must make "donuts" with anything but traditional batter, then flip the script on ramen, using it in an unconventional yet recognizable way.

programme.title: Vegetarian Comfort Food
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith might be a master of meatballs, but in this episode, he shows us that vegetarian food can be down-right soul satisfying. The menu features Kale Pesto Mac & Cheese, Sweet Potato Jamaican Patties with Salsa Verde and Banana Pudding.

programme.title: Sunday Salmon Easter Brunch
programme.desc: Chef Daisy Ryan, an expert in French cooking and cocktails, is cooking up an elegant and easy menu: Salmon Confit, Alsatian Potato Salad and Bernaise Sauce, Lettuces with Mustard Vinaigrette and a fantastic Meyer Lemon Gin Fizz to round things out.

programme.title: Plant-Based Budget Meals
programme.desc: Frankie busts the myth that eating plant-based is expensive. Preparing these good-for-you meals is all about eating seasonally and shopping the bulk aisle to save money on produce. It’s nutritious and great for the planet. Win-win!

programme.title: Lunches for Work
programme.desc: A big way to save money is to prepare homemade lunches for work. Frankie shows us how to make five delicious lunches for the whole work week. You'll be saving money, and you might even be more productive at work after a nutritious homemade lunch!

programme.desc: We’re not doggin’ you when we tell you that these are the tastiest hot dog recipes you’ll find. We’ve got a sweet & savory churro dog, magnificent mini corn dogs, and even a hot dog pie. Wiener wiener hot dog dinner!

programme.title: In the Raw
programme.desc: No need to turn your stove on for these delicious raw dishes! We've got poke tuna tacos, avocado pesto, and a crunchy raw veggie sushi that is sure to make your meal both filling and flavorful.

programme.desc: Stephanie challenges herself to learn more about Caribbean food. Meeting with home cook Kat Williams, who teaches her about Jerk chicken and the art of rice and peas and then restaurant owner Chef Tony who shows her the secret to oxtail.

programme.desc: Stephanie cooks Thai and Peruvian dishes with home chef Brittaney Bunjong and swaps stories about growing up in the kitchen with their moms. Rediscovering the joys and influence of those flavors on her own cooking.

programme.title: Key Ingredients of West African Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie meets Nigerian chefs, Eros and JP, to learn the basics of cooking West African cuisine. From palm oil to locust beans to asaro; Stephanie tests her knowledge and her skills - using these unfamiliar ingredients.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Mother’s Day has a special place in Chef Derrell’s life; he shares his favorite family meal of shrimp with grits, cheddar biscuits and stories from past celebrations. Solo meals include grit cakes, shrimp ceviche and a breakfast biscuit sandwich.

programme.title: Sunday Supper
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is serving up Sunday Supper with his signature meatballs with creamy polenta, parmesan crisps and a spicy gremolata for the family meal. Solo meals are full of flavor with a meatball soup and a delicious meatball mozzarella sub.

programme.title: Michigan Coney Dogs and Ohio State Po' Boys
programme.desc: We're in Ann Arbor, Michigan where Chef Frank Fejeran is taking us on a trip to a beautiful Buddhist farm and making his local take on the classic Michigan Coney Dog.

programme.title: South Carolina Beef Ribs and Florida Fried Chicken
programme.desc: Boiled peanuts and beef ribs at a South Carolina tailgate; an early morning shrimping trip on the Florida Gulf.

programme.title: Florida State Pork Loin and Tennessee Stuffed Quail
programme.desc: Chef Tom Gray makes a delicious FSU-inspired tailgate dish; the world's best bacon in Tennessee.

programme.title: It’s Floofy and Everything’s Fine
programme.desc: Meghan designs decadently delicious cream puffs and cookies to serve for any occasion and shows the viewer at home the sweet tips and tricks behind the sweet treats.

programme.title: The Opposite of a Hot Mess
programme.desc: Meghan takes your fears about layer cakes and chocolate and throws them out the window. She offers up insider know how and can do-ness to craft up the perfect treats.

programme.title: Take The Time To Do It Right
programme.desc: No one said making pie or a macaroon was easy, but Meghan shows you how to do so with a lot less mess and a lot less stress. She takes the time to share her creative take on these classic confections.

programme.title: Bundt and Roll With It
programme.desc: Get fancy AF in the kitchen by taking your baking skills to 100. It’s all about making your bundt cake bounce and high rolling with your roll cake.

programme.title: Hawaii Spamfest
programme.desc: Hawaii and Spam go together like,...well, they just do, and Amy Shuster is in Honolulu to try its many inceptions at the 14th annual Waikiki Spam Jam.

programme.title: New Orleans French Quarter Festival
programme.desc: In New Orleans, Amy is at the French Quarter Festival taking in a little jazz and a lot of Cajun fare.

programme.title: Combo Meal!
programme.desc: This week, Amy hits the road for the Indio International Tamales Festival. But wait, there's more! We check out Texas Crab in Crystal Beach and then load up on guac and all things avo at Fallbrook's annual Avocado Fest.

programme.title: Sweet Tears of Joy
programme.desc: Watch these together.. but maybe don't try to eat them. This week, Amy Shuster is at the Warkworth Maple Syrup Festival and then heads to Zibelemärit — The Onion Market & Festival in Bern, Switzerland. It's so great you'll cry!

programme.title: German Christmas Market
programme.desc: Discover a true Christmas wonderland as Amy Shuster visits Germany's Christkindlmarkt, a Christmas festival dating back to the 16th century.

programme.title: Wasabi & Strawberry Cheesecake
programme.desc: Tastemaker Emmy Cho travels to Shizuoka and Yokohama to discover the secrets of Kit Kat's Wasabi and Strawberry Cheesecake flavors.

programme.title: Matcha & Ogura Toast
programme.desc: Outside Kyoto, Emmy learns the intricacies and traditions of making matcha, and visits a 600-year-old tea farm. Later, Emmy takes in the cafe culture of Nagoya through Ogura toast and a handful of local specialties.

programme.title: Shichimi 7 Spice Blend & Rum Raisin
programme.desc: In Nagano, Emmy heads to a shichimi pepper farm and a 300-year-old spice shop to learn the history of the 7 spice blend. Later, Emmy tries Tokyo's popular treats to find out how rum raisin gained such prominence in the area.

programme.title: Oceanside in Okinawa
programme.desc: Ocean breeze, turquoise waters and a whole lot of amazing cuisine. Marko and Alex are soaking up that island life in Okinawa, Japan and learning what makes it so unique.

programme.title: The L.A. Lifestyle
programme.desc: Green juice, avocado toast, and surfers galore. Marko and Alex are back home in Los Angeles to explore their town, staycation style. From downtown to the beach, the guys do everything fun under the sun in the city of angels.

programme.title: Cooking off the Land on Orcas Island
programme.desc: We visit Orcas Island to meet Jay Blackinton, a farmer & chef who is redefining farm-to-table for his customers. His menu changes daily and is made exclusively with what he and his team have grown on the island.

programme.title: Molecular Gastronomy in San Diego
programme.desc: We meet Chef Richard Blais, winner of Bravo's "Top Chef All-Stars" and successful restauranteur. His newest concept, Juniper & Ivy, on the outskirts of San Diego's Little Italy offers diners refined contemporary American food with a whimsical twist.

programme.title: Elevated Mediterranean in Chicago
programme.desc: We meet Chef Jimmy Bannos Jr., two time nominee for the James Beard Foundation Award for Rising Star Chef, and fourth generation restaurateur. His concept, The Purple Pig, is fueled by timeless flavors that reflect his Greek and Italian roots.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From the funniest feline fails, to the cutest of kittens we've dug out the very best the internet has to offer, and we've the cream of the crop right here.

programme.title: My House And Other Animals
programme.desc: Meet the modern-day Dr Doolittles with a passion for all creatures great and small: the unsung heroes of the wildlife world, whose homes have become havens for every animal imaginable.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The beautiful underwater world is filled with all kinds of mysterious aquatic animals here in "Cute Pet Guide"! Forbidden land on the seabed?! With fierce aquatic creatures appear randomly?! Cute looking frogs that bring good luck?! Biology class: Witness how tadpoles turn into frogs?! Fish and shrimps gather in the water to compete for beauty?!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: This programme finds Dr. Matt battling to fix a greyhound's broken leg to get it back on the track. We meet Matt's wife, Claire, a horse vet, who uses the latest technology to treat three troubled racehorses. But down on the farm Matt finds the old-fashioned way is best when it comes to finding out if a cow is pregnant.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Dagenham a terrified Jack Russell called Phoebe is found abandoned in a travellers' site full of rubbish. Surrounded by danger and left with a badly broken leg she must undergo a three hour operation but will she ever be able to walk again?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sugar gliders have bodies similar to that of a mustelid, and has a long, curly tail that cannot grab anything. Males are larger than females, measuring 25-30 cm long from nose to tail. Their fur is thick and soft, generally bluish-gray in color, but can also be yellow, tan, or white. The area from their nose to the middle of their back is black, while their abdomen, throat and chest are creamy white in color.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt tackles some weighty issues when the fattest parrot he has ever seen pays him a visit, in the sixth programme of the series Matt conducts an emergency caesarean to save the life of Penny the cat, and helps a swan which has been the victim of a brutal mugging.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In London, an underweight, heavily pregnant dog has been brought into the Blue Cross Animal hospital by its owner. The mum to be needs emergency surgery to deliver her pups and because of her poor condition Inspector Annie Simmonds has been called in to investigate. Will Bailey and her pups make it through the operation?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet clean to bring you the most entertaining puppy clips out there: overexcited pups, pilfering pups, pups who fall asleep in their dinner bowls, puppy vloggers, driving pups, and even a look at the latest craze: pups who go into a quivering frenzy at the sight of-K doorstoppers.

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun. Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine. The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series. Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie. High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The extremly cute capybara loves massage, black-footed penguins from Africa show off their superb diving abilities, be careful cause mini pigs aren't mini in size at all, subverting your imagination towards them, and uncovering ecology of the incredible gentle giant giraffe. "Cute Pet Guide" invites you to a trip to the zoo full of surprises!

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep8
programme.desc: Ep08 Daniel menyesaki ibunya menyembunyikan sesuatu. Roz pula menyelinap masuk pengkalan operasi Gagak Putih dan telah diserang. Roz berdepan dengan kesilapan masa silamnya sebagai seorang ibu, isteri dan ejen perisik, yang kini kembali untuk memusnahkan keluarganya.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep1

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep2
programme.desc: Ep02 Roz cuba menenangkan Indah yang risaukan Rin dan Daniel yang telah mulakan penyiasatan. Namun Daniel tidak mahu mendengar nasihat ibunya, Roz. Daniel dan Roz menggunakan cara berbeza untuk mencari Rin. Pihak polis menerima rakaman pesanan suara Rin.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep3
programme.desc: Ep03 Roz kembali beraksi setelah lama bersara, dengan bantuan Ejen Mah. Dia sampai ke lokasi yang disangkakan Rin ada di situ, malangnya pihak polis dan Daniel juga sampai ke situ. Daniel menyerang Roz kerana dia sangka Roz adalah penculik. Roz cuba melindungi identitinya sebagai seorang perisik.

programme.title: Family Spy S1 Ep4
programme.desc: Ep04 Roz, Datin Seri dan Ejen Mah kembali beraksi untuk menolong Roz menyelamatkan cucunya, Rin. Mereka dapat mengesan lokasi sebenar Rin dan menyelamatkannya sebelum Daniel dan polis tiba. Rin kini tahu identiti sebenar Opah Roz.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E02 - Blue Bucket Oregon Trail
programme.desc: Hoy en Fiebre del Oro, Tom y su hija Kia, están en el camino de Oregon, a la caza de la legendaria Blue Bucket Mine.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E04 - The Bears that Couldn't Be
programme.desc: Temperate Rain Forest. Jim and Corey search for an epic hunting spot deep in the coastal rain forest of Vancouver Island that Jim last explored 20 years ago.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E07 - Swimming with Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Manny nada con esturiones gigantes del golfo en el río Suwanee.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E08 - Snapping Turtles of the Santa Fe
programme.desc: Manny explora el río Santa Fe en busca de caimanes, tortugas mordedoras y otros animales salvajes.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E09 - Wild Boars, Wild Nights Part 1
programme.desc: Manny caza jabalíes eurasiáticos salvajes con una lanza, tanto de día como de noche. Ah, y a Manny le muerde su mejor amigo.

programme.title: Savage Wild - S04:E10 - Wild Boars, Wild Nights Part 2
programme.desc: ¡Saquen a los perros! Manny aprende la forma más eficaz de cazar jabalíes.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E03 - Biggest
programme.desc: The Biggest? An Elephant? A Giraffe? A Hippopotamus? Or the humpback whale which is three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighs more than a dozen hippos. But which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E04 - Smartest
programme.desc: ¿Son inteligentes los animales? Por supuesto. Pero, ¿cuál es el más inteligente de todos? ¿El chimpancé socialmente complejo? ¿La ingeniosa araña bola? ¿La arquitectónica termita? ¿El curioso delfín? ¿O el inimitable pulpo?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E05 - Strongest
programme.desc: ¿Cómo se decide cuál es el animal más fuerte del Planeta? Wild Ones compara la fuerza de la más pequeña de las hormigas con la de un poderoso oso pardo, o la de un cocodrilo mortal con la del indestructible rinoceronte.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E06 - Cutest
programme.desc: El encantador canguro. El adorable koala. La hermosa mariposa. El alegre pez payaso. O el adorable periquito: ¿cuál es el más mono de todos?

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E04 - Naturally Exotic
programme.desc: Este episodio de Milagros de la Naturaleza le lleva de viaje desde Antigua, en el Caribe, a las favoritas de los escaladores: las Montañas Azules de Nueva Gales del Sur, Australia, y luego de vuelta al Caribe para adentrarse en la belleza de las Islas Vírgenes Británicas, con impresionantes playas de arena blanca y aguas turquesas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E05 - Naturally Fierce
programme.desc: Visite el invernal Polo Norte desde la comodidad de su sofá, ya que este episodio nos lleva de viaje al gélido Ártico y luego a Quebec para contemplar el fiordo más meridional en marea baja, antes de viajar a Alberta para contemplar la magnitud del río Sasquachuan a su paso por las Montañas Rocosas.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E06 - Naturally Forged
programme.desc: En este episodio de Milagros de la Naturaleza visita varias islas diferentes. Veremos las impresionantes terrazas rocosas de Taiwán y el majestuoso volcán de la mítica isla de Bali. Seguimos con la isla de Jersey, que da nombre a una parte de Nueva York, y por último visitamos la espectacular Madeira, que presenta una asombrosa variedad de paisajes a pesar de sus pocos kilómetros de longitud.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E07 - Naturally Majestic
programme.desc: Siga los pasos de Indiana Jones. En este episodio de Milagros de la Naturaleza visitamos las maravillas del desierto de Gobi, uno de los más antiguos del mundo, y luego las exuberantes y verdes laderas del norte de Mongolia. Desde allí viajaremos 5.000 kilómetros hacia el sureste, hasta Jordania y el Mar Muerto.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E10 - Reca
programme.desc: Sumérgete en la temporada de Dropped mientras los hermanos recapitulan una épica aventura de 30 días a través de la sabana canadiense.

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E01 - Back In The Brooks
programme.desc: 經過幾年的努力，Keefer兄弟終於回到阿拉斯加的荒野，探索碎石路。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E02 - Maniac Mountain
programme.desc: 十多年之後，狂人山為兄弟們帶來了另一個開創性的成就。

programme.title: Dropped - S08:E03 - Arctic Apex
programme.desc: Keefer兄弟陷入灰熊與狼之間的對決，挑戰誰才是真正食品鏈的頂端。

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: Cuando los seres humanos son un grave peligro para sí mismos ... Horas desesperadas analiza catástrofes nucleares e industriales como el desastre de la central nuclear de Fukushima en Japón, el de la central nuclear de Chernóbil en Ucrania, el vertido de petróleo en aguas profundas del Golfo de México, el del Savar Plaza en Bangladesh y el del gas de Bhopal en la India. Cuando se produce una catástrofe en una central nuclear, el desastre resultante puede ser, literalmente, fuera de escala y durar décadas.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: La navegación es un negocio peligroso, de hecho...... Las horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes ocurridas en alta mar, como el desastre del transbordador Sewol en Corea del Sur, el Ferry Estonia en el mar Báltico, el hundimiento del Titanic, el Exxon Valdez en Prince William Sound Alaska, el Express Samina en Portes Islets, los ataques piratas al Maersk Alabama y al Seabourn Spirit, y el Costa Concordia en el mar Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller...... Los accidentes aéreos son las peores pesadillas de la mayoría de la gente. Horas desesperadas repasa las principales catástrofes de la historia de la aviación, como los vuelos MH17 y MH370 de Malaysia Airlines, el vuelo 447 de Air France, el vuelo 9525 de Germanwings, el desastre del aeropuerto de Tenerife, las catástrofes de los transbordadores espaciales Challenger y Columbia, el accidente del C-130 de la Fuerza Aérea Indonesia en Sumatra en 2015, el accidente del Antonov An-124 de Irkutsk en 1997 y el accidente del vuelo 4590 del Concorde.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E11 - Road and Rail Disasters
programme.desc: Abróchese el cinturón y manténgase alerta...... Horas desesperadas analiza los accidentes de tráfico y ferroviarios, entre ellos el accidente ferroviario español de Santiago de Compostela, un accidente de carretera en Pakistán, el accidente de un camión petrolero en Nigeria en el que murieron 96 personas, el accidente ferroviario del Queen of the Sea en Sri Lanka, los accidentes provocados por la niebla en Italia y el Reino Unido, un accidente de cien vehículos en la autopista A1 en Austria, un accidente de carretera en México y un accidente de Amtrak en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E12 - Environmental Disaster
programme.desc: Más vale prevenir que curar...... Horas desesperadas analiza el Protocolo de Kioto y el peligro de la subida del nivel del mar. El programa examina las causas de las catástrofes medioambientales, como los vertederos, la gran mancha de basura del Pacífico, los vertidos de petróleo, la contaminación atmosférica y la destrucción de la selva tropical, así como los efectos destructivos de las catástrofes medioambientales, como el agotamiento de la capa de ozono y el aumento de las temperaturas en el Ártico.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E02 - Nightmare Canyon Part 2
programme.desc: Parte 2: El fin de semana de escalada de Justin y Jeremy Harris ha resultado en un serio peligro para los hermanos. Con Justin totalmente incapacitado cuando se rompe la pierna le toca a Jeremy ir solo y tratar de conseguir ayuda. A medida que cae la noche y las temperaturas descienden hasta el punto de congelación, el tiempo es crítico para que los hermanos sobrevivan.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E03 - Under the Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal emprendió una corta caminata en el Parque Nacional Joshua Tree, pero en el calor del día se dio la vuelta y se perdió. Sus seis días de supervivencia a temperaturas abrasadoras, sin comida ni agua, son casi milagrosos.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E04 - Treestand Nightmare
programme.desc: Cuando el Dr. Joe Baumgardner, ávido cazador con arco, se dispone a realizar el mantenimiento rutinario de sus puestos en los árboles, una caída de seis metros le deja con una pierna gravemente rota y a kilómetros de ayuda en los profundos bosques de Mississippi.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E05 - Crushed by a Boulder Part 1
programme.desc: Mientras escalaba en solitario el monte Goddard, una remota cima de la Sierra de California, una roca aplasta la pierna de Gregg Hein, que se precipita montaña abajo. Apenas puede detener la caída y se enfrenta a una terrible fractura.
